text:
maria: quick note — during today's eu1 TLS rekey window we saw SSE clients keep TCP open but stop getting event frames for ~30-60s, then resume. console showed no FIN/RST.

sam: do we have traces or alert spikes?

maria: ops-bot flagged sse.no-output spike. sample trace 0f9e3b at https://console/redwood/trace/0f9e3b.

jonathan: probably our keepalive-squelch suppression kicking during rekey. clients debounce reconnects so they stay 'connected' but silent.

lee: can you paste the repro request?

maria: repro (intermittent):

```
curl -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  "https://eu1-api.redwood.ai/v1/streams?model=gpt-4o" --max-time 120
```

maria: observed: no SSE frames for ~45s mid-stream, then frames resume. chat UIs often show spinner and don't surface resumed tokens.

ops-bot: ALERT sse.no-output -> 84 events in 5m (eu1). top tenants: acct-42, acct-77.

sam: metrics show `sse.keepalive_suppressed_total` spike aligning with `proxy.tls_rekey_count`. low tracing sample; increasing to 15% for 1h.

jonathan: proposals: 1) runtime emits `x-rekey-hint` header during rekey windows; 2) clients add short stall->resume heuristic when hint present (e.g., no frames >10s -> reconnect/resume); 3) telemetry: label suppression metrics with tenant/route and add `sse.stall_seconds` histogram; 4) ops: temporarily relax squelch in eu1.

product: product prefers graceful resume but wants UIs to surface resumed tokens — if client-side fix insufficient we may need forced reconnects.

lee: ops will flip squelch threshold to 0.5 in eu1 now and watch.

sam: I'll open CANARY flag + dashboard banner and post trace slices to RB-2234.

maria: created RB-2234. owners: maria (investigate), sam (flags/telemetry), jonathan (runtime), lee (ops). target hotfix today, full fix next release.

jonathan: also add a small console alert rule correlating `sse.keepalive_suppressed_total` with `sse.no-output` so CS can triage per-tenant.

maria: ok, will update ticket with traces and a short postmortem after hotfix. :thumbsup:
